name: ULS empty-latent noise (colored, offset, fractal, character)
plain: Empty-latent noise types with a cross-fade to white using the Gaussian sum rule. Pink, brown and blue use a proper radial filter with signed beta. The docstring acknowledges this has small effect at denoise 1.0.
math:
Colored: w(f)=|f|^(−β/2), w(0)=0, spec×w, normalize. pink β=1, brown β=2, blue β=−1.
Character c: out = normalize(√(1−c²)·white + c·shaped).
Offset: normalize(white + OFFSET_MAX·c·dc), dc capped to B,C (not per-frame, to avoid flicker).

claims.text: Offset per-frame caused frame-mean brightness flicker on video, DC capped to batch and channel
